subject: skill/stack/sqlite
claim: The control database enables WAL and a configurable 5-second busy timeout for its one-orchestrator, many-observer deployment shape. Consumers open SQLite with mode=ro; a missing control database is an error rather than an empty database, and read-only handles reject writes.
notes: Repo conformance edit: retained the configured WAL, busy-timeout, and read-only contracts while removing unverified local practices about checkpointing, transaction size, reader lifetime, and filesystem placement.
